title: Sephiroth in Kingdom Hearts Was Voiced by a Member of NSYNC
hook:
In 2002 Square gave Kingdom Hearts a Hollywood voice cast, and the secret superboss Sephiroth went to Lance Bass of NSYNC. He says he has never beaten his own boss. Did you?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know the most feared secret boss in the first Kingdom Hearts was voiced by a member of N Sync? In May of two thousand two, Square announced the English voice cast for Kingdom Hearts, and it read like a Hollywood guest list. Haley Joel Osment, the kid from The Sixth Sense, was Sora. David Gallagher played Riku, and Hayden Panettiere played Kairi. Mandy Moore was Aerith, and Sean Astin and David Boreanaz were in there too. And so was Lance Bass, the singer from the boy band N Sync. Bass played Sephiroth, the one winged villain borrowed from Final Fantasy Seven. The casting made headlines months before the game even reached America. In Kingdom Hearts, Sephiroth is an optional boss hiding in the Coliseum, and he is brutal. Plenty of players spent hours on that fight and never saw the end of it. Bass himself has admitted something funny about it. He has never beaten his own boss. He has also happily called himself the original Sephiroth on social media, and fans still bring it up. So for one game, the toughest fight in Kingdom Hearts came with a pop star's voice behind it. Did you ever beat Sephiroth in the first Kingdom Hearts? Follow for more gaming history.
